# Novik AI

> Novik is an AI-powered clinical decision-support assistant for dental professionals. It supports review of de-identified medical history, medications and planned dental procedures. Diagnosis, professional judgment and treatment decisions remain with the treating clinician.

## Languages
- [English](https://novik.ai/)
- [Español](https://novik.ai/es)

## Clinical topics / Temas clínicos
Educational information for dental professionals, not individual clinical protocols. Sources and scope are stated on each page; no independent clinical review is claimed.

- [Clinical topics](https://novik.ai/clinical-topics)
- [Temas clínicos](https://novik.ai/es/clinical-topics)
- [Polypharmacy and drug interactions in dentistry](https://novik.ai/clinical-topics/polypharmacy)
- [Polimedicación e interacciones farmacológicas en odontología](https://novik.ai/es/clinical-topics/polypharmacy)
- [Anticoagulated patients in dentistry](https://novik.ai/clinical-topics/anticoagulants)
- [Pacientes anticoagulados en odontología](https://novik.ai/es/clinical-topics/anticoagulants)
- [Bisphosphonates and denosumab in dentistry](https://novik.ai/clinical-topics/antiresorptives)
- [Bisfosfonatos y denosumab en odontología](https://novik.ai/es/clinical-topics/antiresorptives)

## Legal and scope
- [Terms of use](https://novik.ai/terms-of-use)
- [Privacy policy](https://novik.ai/privacy-policy)
- [Legal notice](https://novik.ai/legal-notice)
- [Cookie policy](https://novik.ai/cookie-policy)

Core functionality is free during open beta. No HIPAA certification is claimed. Do not enter patient identifiers. Novik is independent and is not affiliated with the scientific organisations whose logos appear on the website. Public information is available as rendered HTML in English and Spanish. Contact: info@novik.ai.
